excerpt_i18n.en: Lei Feng Net News: Users have long suffered from the high cost of tokens. "I burned through thousands of dollars worth of tokens, but the Agent still didn't finish the job." This is perhaps the most awkward and common situation faced by the early adopters of "raising shrimp." As Agents increasingly take over workflows, people are starting to see efficiency issues when weighing the results. Sometimes they can independently complete requirement analysis and multiple rounds of revisions, delivering usable copy or code directly. Many developers attribute this to the Agent's architecture design, the completeness of the toolchain, or the depth of prompt engineering. But the more fundamental contradiction is that the "execution capability" of large models themselves—the ability to efficiently complete tasks—may be far from meeting industrial-grade standards. A veces pueden completar de forma autónoma el análisis de requisitos y múltiples rondas de modificaciones, entregando directamente textos o códigos utilizables; otras veces, sin embargo, fallan al desglosar tareas complejas.

items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网讯 你可以从同事.skill 的爆火中看到两种截然不同的时代情绪，其一固然是对 Markdown 文件“大变活人”这一魔幻现实的试探，而反面则是如今对模型能力的评价，已经离不开工作级任务的场景。 “AI 能不能替代程序员”的老生常谈之下，今天的真问题是，国产大模型能在多大程度上接管开发工作流。 这背后是一个被反复验证的痛点：当 AI Agent 被放进真实项目，它并没有想象中那么“能扛活”。它能开始任务，但执行过程反复中断，多轮对话后上下文丢失，结果前后不一致。面对非标准需求时，工具调用也频频失误。你一觉醒来，发现流程早已卡死，标准结局总是如此。 问题的根源不在 Agent 的外壳，而在底层大模型本身还缺乏稳定可靠的“执行力”和“决策力”。 4月7日，阿里云通义千问 Qwen3.6-Plus 正式上线，在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 编程测试中超越了 Claude Opus 4.5，拿下全球编程模型榜首。 但我们决定换一种更接近真实场景的方式测一次，不用单点的 Benchmark，而是用两套真实复杂任务，覆盖“决策”与“执行”两条能力轴，全面评估 Qwen 3.6-Plus 的智能体能力上限。 01 核心实测——“双线”考核： 复杂决策 × Agentic Coding 现实中高价值的工作级任务，往往是多因素、多步骤、有约束、有风险，和“一步到位”的 ChatBot 对模型有着完全不同的能力需求。因此，大模型从“聊天工具”变成真正的智能体，复杂决策能力是一个分水岭。 在本次测评中，我们选择智能体决策与智能体编程两个高难度、高价值场景，构建了双线考核体系，检验模型在真实复杂任务中的自主规划、动态决策与工程落地能力： ▎ case1 教育改革试点方案设计：复杂规划与现实决策 我们采用具备主动执行能力的代表性智能体框架 OpenClaw 进行测试，在教育改革背景下

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng News: Two contrasting sentiments of the era can be seen in the viral popularity of colleague.skill. One is a curiosity about the magical reality of Markdown files "bringing people to life," while the other reflects that today's evaluation of model capabilities is inseparable from work-level task scenarios. Beneath the cliché of "Can AI replace programmers," the real question today is to what extent domestic large models can take over the development workflow. Behind this lies a repeatedly validated pain point: when an AI Agent is placed in a real project, it is not as "capable of handling the workload" as imagined. It can start tasks, but the execution process is frequently interrupted, context is lost after multiple rounds of dialogue, and results are inconsistent. When faced with non-standard requirements, tool calls also frequently fail. You wake up to find the process has long been stuck—this is always the standard outcome. The root of the problem lies not in the Agent's shell, but in the underlying large model itself, which still lacks stable and reliable "execution capability" and "decision-making ability." On April 7, Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi Qianwen Qwen3.6-Plus was officially launched, surpassing Claude Opus 4.5 in the Terminal-Bench 2.0 programming test to claim the top spot in global programming models. However, we decided to test it in a way closer to real-world scenarios, not with isolated benchmarks, but with two sets of real complex tasks covering the two capability axes of "decision-making" and "execution," to comprehensively evaluate Qwen 3.6-Pl.
excerpt_i18n.es: Noticias de Leifeng. En la popularidad explosiva de colleague.skill se pueden observar dos estados de ánimo de la época completamente opuestos. Bajo el tópico de "si la IA puede reemplazar a los programadores", la verdadera cuestión hoy es hasta qué punto los grandes modelos nacionales pueden hacerse cargo del flujo de trabajo de desarrollo. Detrás de esto hay un punto débil repetidamente verificado: cuando un Agente de IA se coloca en un proyecto real, no resulta tan "capaz de soportar la carga" como se imaginaba. excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng News, April 16 - Alibaba released Happy Oyster, an open world model product focused on real-time construction and interaction. Based on a native multimodal architecture, Happy Oyster supports multimodal input and joint audio-video generation, and can continuously receive user instructions during the generation process, enabling real-time visual response and ongoing performance. If AGI is the ultimate vision and embodied intelligence is the material carrier, then the world model is the cognitive foundation of it all. It occupies a uniquely special position in the technological trajectory, serving as the evolutionary node from "predicting the next word" in large models to "predicting the next physical state." This has made the world model a highly sought-after track. On the 16th, Tencent open-sourced HY-World 2.0, and the next day, Qunhe Technology was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, becoming the "first global spatial intelligence stock." Zooming out, Google, Nvidia, Meta, and World Labs, led by Li Feifei, have all long laid out plans in this track. As competition heats up, we can't help but ask: before the grandest vision is realized, what early-stage application scenarios can provide resources for the future battle? Among the many possible application directions, game development is a frequently mentioned choice by major companies. The reason is not hard to understand. Video models have proven that AI is already adept at delivering visuals, and interactive world models have taken a step further, attempting to give users a space they can enter, modify, and that can respond to their interactions.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de abril, Alibaba lanzó Happy Oyster, un modelo de mundo abierto centrado en la construcción e interacción en tiempo real. Basado en una arquitectura multimodal nativa, Happy Oyster admite entrada multimodal y generación conjunta de audio y video, y durante el proceso de generación puede recibir instrucciones continuas del usuario, logrando una respuesta en tiempo real y una representación continua de las imágenes. Si AGI es la visión última y la inteligencia encarnada el portador material, entonces el modelo de mundo es la base cognitiva de todo ello. excerpt_i18n.en: Lei Feng Net News: After several release windows, on April 24, DeepSeek officially launched its latest flagship model, DeepSeek-V4. This release features a million-character ultra-long context, with impressive performance in Agent capabilities, world knowledge, and reasoning. Curiosamente, el 8 de abril DeepSeek lanzó discretamente los modos experto y rápido, lo que llevó a especular que se trataba de distintas versiones de V4. Esta hipótesis fue confirmada oficialmente: según el tamaño de parámetros, V4 se lanza simultáneamente en dos versiones, pro y flash.
